notes.title: Steam Workshop Update
notes.notes:
Halloween is Here!

Happy Halloween!
The best time of the year is here. Let's celebrate it properly. What do we need? First up some costumes!

There are some characters that dressed up for Halloween this year. 

Halloween Skins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/0c1259c413a89298e0539d50b90baae3d7cb7b96.png

Jester
Santa
Boner Brothers
Sister Godfrieda


You want even more skins? I got you covered. Introducing...

Steam Workshop Support

It's now possible to create custom maps and skins for Motördoom using Unity. 
Mods can be uploaded to the Steam Workshop making it very easy to distribute your Mods to other players.
You can find the Documentation here:
Mod Documentation Motördoom

Maps
You can create your own maps using the before mentioned tool. The maps let you define which and how many enemies spawn and you can also add custom objectives to your level that you can complete in career mode as well. You can build maps that have almost all things that the standard game levels feature, giving you complete freedom of making your dream Motördoom Stage a reality.
Something missing you would like to add? Join the Hobo Cat Games Discord Server and let me know!

Skins 
Next to maps it's also possible to create custom skins with the Mod tool. You can create a simple texture swap for the character and bike skins or go all in and change the whole model. I can't wait to see some characters from other games appear in Motördoom!

Attention: 
Mods do only work correctly on Windows at the moment. While you can load and play them on Linux, shaders are not displayed correctly. I hopefully can make them work on Linux in the future as well. 


Night of the Chainsaw Bike Massacre
A BIG Thank You goes out to Flunked Punk who helped me test the workshop feature and already created some awesome levels and skins for the game.

Check out Flunked Punk's Workshop Collection:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/aefcf768bce94430c57afc2c3cb0e6d432f352d3.jpg
Featuring two levels and two Skin packs ready to use in Motördoom.
You can get the Night of the Chainsaw Bike Massacre collection here!


As always thanks for playing. Enjoy Halloween!

Chris
Hobo Cat Games

notes.title: Gameplay Update: Shoot Without Aiming!
notes.notes:
Gameplay Update - Shoot without Aiming

Since a lot of players found it hard to do tricks whilst aiming and shooting, I added the feature to shoot without aiming. If you press or hold the shoot button you will now shoot straight ahead. If a enemy is in front of you, your character will automatically aim at that enemy. So there is a auto targeting system that targets enemies in front of you automatically. Of course you can still slow down time and aim manually if you want to. This helps targeting enemies you want to focus on like bosses or exploding foes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/ada6dc969c7bd716d41949c6b44175e8c3a8abeb.gif

Next to that major change here are the other things that have been changed/fixed/:

Additions:

Shooting without aiming at random target in front of you


Changes:

Character can't go beyond level 50 (no health/damage increase after level 50) in Single Run mode
Less health/damage gain with level up 
Healthpotions now heal a fix amount instead of a percentage of the players max health
Manual and grind balance upgrades now also lower difficulty increase over time
More points needed for level up in every difficulty
Points needed for level up increases every 20 levels instead of every 25 levels
You wont get hurt from slams anymore
Lowered health of Santa Character
Lowered prices of addons
Lowered the increase of scrap you get from the more scrap addon
Overall balancing


Fixes:

Enemies don't go through floor anymore
Fixed a bug that caused new cards to not unlock the first time
Minor menu fixes
